The '''Tarantula Talisman''' is an {{Epic}} [[Accessory]] that makes it so every {{Green|10th}} melee hit on the same enemy deals {{Green|+10%}} damage. 

== Obtaining ==
The '''Tarantula Talisman''' can be obtained as a {{Odds|RNGesus}} drop from any [[Tarantula Broodfather]] of {{SlayerTier|III}} or higher after reaching {{Coll|Spider Slayer LVL 6}}.

=== Drop Chances ===
* {{Stier|3}}: {{Green|0.08%}} (1x)
* {{Stier|4}}: {{Green|0.17%}} (1x)

=== Salvaging ===
'''Tarantula Talisman''' can be salvaged for {{Item|Spider Essence|amount=50}}.

== Trivia ==
*The head's texture is based on a {{Item|Spider Eye}}.
*A spider sound plays when the talisman's effect activates.
